Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

zurds 0.0.0.9000

  • zurds_info() reports the package and zufast versions, the default limits, and the compressions this R can read.
  • rds_info() reads the header of an .rds, .rda or serialize() stream, or of a lazy-load database’s index: kind, format, version, the writing and minimum reading R versions, native encoding and compression.
  • rds_str() prints a str()-like summary of a file from its stream alone, without building any object or running any code. It reads XDR, native binary (either byte order) and ASCII streams.
  • rds_toc() lists the objects of an .rda file, with their types, classes, lengths, dimensions, sizes and offsets, without building any of them.
  • rds_scan() reports everything in a file that can run code, reach outside it, or needs a package; rds_is_safe() is TRUE when it finds nothing; rds_deps() lists the packages a file needs. rds_toc() fills risky.
  • rds_read_data() reads data-only files with a reader written in C that builds only vectors, lists and attributes, and never calls unserialize(). The result is identical() to readRDS().
  • rds_extract() reads one object, list element or data frame column without building the rest; use_r = TRUE hands only that item to R.
  • rds_lazyload_toc() and rds_lazyload_extract() list and read lazy-load databases, such as an installed package’s, without forcing promises.
  • vignette("safe-reading") explains how to look at, scan and read files from elsewhere, and what the data-only reader does and does not guarantee.

Developed by Pedro Baltazar.
